svg.title: CEE 7/5 socket-outlet (female holes, male earth pin), mating face, earth pin up
svg.desc: Schematic front view of the circular recess with the earth pin up; the cited sources do not fix the mounting orientation. Two pin holes on a horizontal line, line or neutral not fixed by the sources. Earth pin projecting from the socket, centred above the holes. Rings are female contacts; the filled circle is the male earth pin. Proportions follow 19 mm between pin holes, 10 mm from the hole line to the earth pin and a 4.8 mm earth pin.
